key_findings: Schwann cell Lrp1 knockout causes orofacial mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity, mitochondrial/oxidative stress changes in trigeminal ganglia, and upregulated, sensitized TRPV1 and TRPA1.
Supernatant from Lrp1-deficient Schwann cells (rich in H2O2) is sufficient to induce orofacial hypersensitivity and activate trigeminal neurons via TRPV1/TRPA1.
